text_block_list.name: Tazuna Hayakawa
text_block_list.text:
Congratulations! You've finally gathered 
all your team members.

text_block_list.name: Tazuna Hayakawa
text_block_list.text:
Without further ado, I have prepared a 
clubroom for your team.

text_block_list.name: Tazuna Hayakawa
text_block_list.text:
...However, right now we only have the 
bare minimum. We don't have enough 
training equipment yet, either.

text_block_list.name: Tazuna Hayakawa
text_block_list.text:
However, as we win in the "Aoharu Cup" and 
the team's ranking goes up, our budget 
will increase accordingly as well!

text_block_list.name: Tazuna Hayakawa
text_block_list.text:
That way, we can make our team training 
even more fulfilling and high-level♪

text_block_list.name: Tazuna Hayakawa
text_block_list.text:
To build a better team, please do your 
best to achieve great results in the 
Aoharu Cup!

text_block_list.name: Tazuna Hayakawa
text_block_list.text:
Then without further ado, let's complete 
the necessary procedures to participate in 
the "Aoharu Cup."

text_block_list.name: Tazuna Hayakawa
text_block_list.text:
Here is the entry registration form. 
Please fill in the required details and 
submit it.

text_block_list.name: Tazuna Hayakawa
text_block_list.text: Well then, I wish you the best of luck.

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text:
There's a space for the team name on the 
entry form. How about Team <Carrots>?

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text:
Deciding on "Team Carrots" as the team 
name, it was filled into the race entry 
form!

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text:
From now on, I want us to work hard 
together as one team!
